stem: Amna jogs around the edge of a rectangular park in Islamabad that is 350 meters long and 150 meters wide. She completes 4 full laps. How many kilometers does she jog? (1 kilometer = 1,000 meters)
solution: One lap is the perimeter: \(2(350 + 150) = 1{,}000\) meters \(= 1\) kilometer.

explanation.A: Correct. One lap is \(2(350 + 150) = 1{,}000\) meters, so 4 laps is \(4{,}000\) meters \(= 4\) kilometers.
explanation.B: Incorrect. This uses \(350 + 150 = 500\) meters per lap, only half the perimeter.
explanation.C: Incorrect. This is \(4 \cdot 350 = 1{,}400\) meters; it counts only one side of the park per lap.
explanation.D: Incorrect. This is the distance of a single lap, 1 kilometer; Amna completes 4 laps.

verify:
lap=2*(350+150)
assert lap==1000
ans=Rational(4*lap,1000)
assert ans==4
assert value(choices[answer])==ans
assert all(value(choices[k])!=ans for k in choices if k!=answer)
